card.name: Small words before 'of' or a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, to, any, of, level) that come right before a phrase naming a part, share or extent of something. Seen in hypersensitivity warnings ("or to any") and in general prose ("improvements to the majority").

modes.label: Hypersensitivity 'any'
modes.description: The word 'any' after 'hypersensitivity to ... or to' in contraindication lists, before 'of the excipients' or 'local anesthetic'.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to albuterol, budesonide, or to<< any>> of the excipients.

modes.label: Linking words in general prose
modes.description: 'the', 'to', 'of' or 'level' just before a phrase about a portion or cause in web text.
modes.example: performance improvements to<< the>> majority of your code usually don't result

card.plain: It fires on small linking words that come just before a phrase about a part or share of something, such as 'any' in 'allergic to any of the ingredients'.
